data_points.claim: The poem was recorded in Kenya in 1980, per scholar Francelia Butler's 1989 book
The rhyme is in the public domain in India (old enough by 2018), so the words themselves are free to use
The song is a call-and-response, often sung to the tune of Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
LooLoo Kids' version has ~7.2B views and 19M likes - the category benchmark
The 2018 Billion Surprise Toys version went viral as a meme and later triggered controversial DMCA takedowns over the song's unclear copyright

research_brief.research_summary: Johny Johny Yes Papa is a public-domain, call-and-response nursery rhyme (recorded in Kenya 1980, often sung to Twinkle Twinkle) that became a multi-billion-view kids-content staple. The dominant versions are high-stimulation 'edutainment' that parents and critics increasingly find over-stimulating and 'disturbing' (the Elsgate phenomenon). The clearest opportunity is the opposite: a calm, warm, genuinely cozy father-son take with big readable captions and the full 12-line narrative - the anti-Elsagate that parents actively want. This directly shapes concept c1 (The Pantry Door): warm palette, slow pacing, affectionate dynamic, caption-forward.

technique_references: Flat 2D silhouette character animation (local SVG rig feasible)
Call-and-response pacing: each line gets a distinct physical beat
Squash-and-stretch + anticipation-overshoot for toddler-friendly bouncy motion
metadata.feasibility: 2 characters, simple rig, no complex physical contact - well within the character-animation pipeline's MVP sweet spot
